resumos: Qdrant はスパース BM25 と密ベクトルを融合し、RRF による再ランキングを組み合わせる。
Combines sparse (BM25) and dense (embedding) vectors for hybrid search capabilities in Qdrant.
Vector database that supports payload filtering and optional BM25‑style keyword scoring for hybrid queries.
Qdrant supports hybrid search by allowing vector similarity search combined with metadata filtering and optional text-based retrieval.
